title: FlexLine Workout Relief Tenure Share
content:
| Age of the FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line on the relief date | Share |
|---|---|
| fewer than 24 whole calendar months | 0.75 |
| 24 whole calendar months or more, fewer than 36 | 0.90 |
| 36 whole calendar months or more | 1.00 |

The tenure share follows the age of the line from its open date: fewer than 24 months give 0.75; 24 months or more but fewer than 36 give 0.90; 36 months or more give 1.00. The share multiplies the workout relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent.

Whole calendar months are counted from the open date to the relief date, a month counting only once the relief date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical boundary:* a line opened on 9 April is 35 months old on 8 April three years later (0.90) and 36 months old on 9 April three years later (1.00). A 16.00 USD relief at 0.90 is 14.40 USD before rounding.
